verdict: ROAS is strong and climbing; Google Business activity needs urgent attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.59 for every $1.00 spent, generating $8,276.68 in revenue from 43 purchases — and that return rate climbed a further 12% in the most recent 7-day window, confirmed by a doubling of purchase activity in the last three days versus the three days prior. Instagram reach ticked up 8.5% week-over-week, a positive early signal, though daily reach has softened from its early-September peak, so ad creative is being refreshed to sustain momentum. Your Google Business Profile showed a sharp drop in customer actions — calls, directions, and website clicks — over the past five days, falling from roughly 25–47 actions per day to near zero; we are investigating whether this is a profile issue or a data gap and working to restore visibility immediately. Four project milestones from August are also being brought current this period, with September 30 deliverables — subscribe page rebuild, automation flows, and the monthly report — on track.
